root_idea.summary: The root centers on tasting or perceiving something through consumption; from this develop the notions of food, feeding, taste, and nourishment.
root_idea.development: The basic act of tasting extends to the consumed thing itself, giving food and flavor, and metaphorically to supplying sustenance or conveying something as though it were placed in the mouth.

senses.usage_conditions: The sense covers eating in ordinary contexts, including statements about the amount or satisfaction resulting from eating.

senses.definition: To taste or partake of something, including a drink.
senses.usage_conditions: The verb may describe tasting what is eaten or drunk; in the water episode, it denotes taking or tasting the water rather than merely drinking it.

senses.definition: To feed someone; give someone food or give someone to eat.
senses.usage_conditions: The passive occurrence expresses being fed; active and imperative forms express providing food to another.

senses.definition: To supply someone with sustenance or the means of subsistence.
senses.usage_conditions: This Quran-attested construction presents sustenance as something supplied by the provider, including the theological statement that God is not dependent on being sustained.

senses.definition: To ask for food or ask someone to feed one.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb is used of travelers asking the people of a town for food.
A verbal noun of أَطْعَمَ, including the provision of food in acts of charity or expiation.
The participle denotes the person eating or tasting in the Quranic dietary construction.

senses.definition: Food; anything eaten, including a meal or repast.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can refer to food generally and, by context, to a particular meal or edible provision.

senses.definition: The food or edible provision of the sea.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction طَعَامُ الْبَحْرِ, it denotes what the sea leaves exposed and available to take without fishing, according to the Quranic usage represented here.
The noun denotes the perceptible taste of a consumed thing, including the taste of a drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of a branch or shoot, to receive a graft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use applied to a plant branch or shoot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of an eye, to have a mote cast into it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an extended usage and not as the ordinary meaning of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have power over someone or something; to have the ability to do it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed construction with عَلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eating with the central incisors.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of the manner of eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To taste food so as to acquire an appetite for it; figuratively, to begin an undertaking in a way that invites its completion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The extended sense is preserved from the proverb associated with the imperative form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of a bone, to have or contain marrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use in which the object understood is the marrow-containing bone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal or associative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of two pigeons, to bill, with the male inserting his bill into the female's.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the birds' reciprocal action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign land, revenue, or a tax as a grant or means of support.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized administrative or proprietary use, including lending land for cultivation or assigning its revenue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To graft one branch or shoot onto another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A horticultural use of the Form IV verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast a mote into someone's eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed extended construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of a palm tree or fruit, to bear ripe fruit or become ripe enough to eat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of plants, trees, or fruit reaching edible ripeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For members of a traveling group to eat with one another by taking turns supplying the food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The described arrangement assigns each person a turn to provide food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of two persons, to act like billing pigeons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative reciprocal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of dates, to acquire flavor and become ripe enough to eat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the assimilated Form VIII verb with dates or date fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become unaffected by instruction or correction; to fail to become intelligent or well disciplined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to relate a narrative or discourse, as though asking to taste its flavor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form X construction applied to speech or tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask for or prompt a recitation when the reciter cannot proceed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction used when a prayer leader asks others to supply the words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire a horse's running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use with a horse as the object of desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that is swallowed easily or agreeably, whether solid or liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can include water, juice, oil, vinegar, and similar liquids as well as solid food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An estimable quality in a person, including intelligence, prudence, or good standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the desirable quality or relish of food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grain thrown to birds or bait thrown to fish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for food used to attract or catch an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food that satisfies the eater's stomach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression طَعَامُ طُعْمٍ denotes something nourishing or stomach-satisfying, including the conventional description of Zamzam water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An assigned means of subsistence, such as a land grant, tax, portion of revenue, or surplus entitlement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of an estate or other property assigned for someone's support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An invitation to food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional noun for an occasion or offer of eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or means of gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may characterize a person's livelihood as honest or corrupt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way or manner of eating, and by extension a way of conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe eating and drinking habits, including the conventional distinction between lawful and unlawful earnings or consumption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In some regional usage, especially wheat, barley, dates, or other grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a lexical specialization of the broader word for food, not a restriction on its general meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of a slaughtered camel or sheep, having fat or a fatty flavor; said also of marrow containing the flavor of fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the fatness or fatty taste of animal flesh or marrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Said of water, drinkable or agreeable to drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use applied to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat kept or selected for eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of food, especially grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occupational adjective is applied to a food vendor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Well situated or in good condition with respect to food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or possessive description of someone's food-related condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be in no need of another person's food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic construction expressing independence from or lack of need for someone's provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place or occasion, synonymous with a place or time of eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Supplied with the means of subsistence; provided for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial use extended from being fed to being supported or endowed with provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Endowed with or gifted with someone's affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which affection is treated as something bestowed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who eats vehemently or excessively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intensive description of an eater.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow, regarded as feeding its owner with game.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative instrument name based on the food or game obtained through hunting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The epiglottis or the throat and fauces, the passage by which food and drink enter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use; the related expression can denote seizing or squeezing someone's throat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two corresponding anterior toes or talons of a bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The talons are so called because they seize flesh for the bird to eat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk that has acquired a flavor or pleasant odor from the skin of its container.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of milk altered by contact with its vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who feeds others abundantly or entertains many guests; by extension, one associated with plentiful eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or woman and to a group known for feeding or eating much.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sound or free from defect in make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative expression describing conformity or sound construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lips of a horse, or the area beneath the muzzle extending to their extremities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical term with some variation in the precise part intended.
